title: Autopilot Task Queue
description: Ordered, committed list of task files for autopilot to work through. Entry status (queued/in-progress/done/stuck) is derived from each task file's own requirement state at read time and is never stored here, so the queue cannot drift from ground truth.

queue.description: Entries in run order: the drain loop works the first runnable entry first

taskFile.description: Project-relative path to a task JSON file with a requirements array

addedAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the entry was queued

hold.description: Keep the entry in the queue but skip it when draining

notes.description: Free-form note shown in queue listings

startedAt.description: Stamped by run.sh the first time the entry is picked up (informational; status is always derived from the task file)

completedAt.description: Stamped by run.sh when the entry finishes draining (all requirements passed, stuck, or invalid)
